chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Thumb the bass
exercises.purpose: Steady alternating bass with the thumb.

params.action: thumb alternates low-E(5th) and A(4th) strings

exercises.coaching: Fingerpicking starts with the thumb. On C, your thumb alternates the low E and A strings — a steady heartbeat bass. Everything else waits.

exercises.name: Travis pattern

params.pattern: thumb low-E, finger G-string, thumb A, finger B-string (repeat)
params.cue: thumb on the beat, fingers on the off-beats

exercises.coaching: Travis pattern: thumb on low E, a finger on the G string, thumb on A, a finger on the B string. Repeat. Slow and even — that rolling sound is fingerstyle.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Strumming is one texture; fingerpicking is another. Today: the Travis pattern — thumb on bass, fingers alternating. A whole new sound.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Start with the thumb. On C, alternate low E and A strings — steady, like a heartbeat. That bass line is the foundation.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Travis: thumb low E, finger G string, thumb A, finger B string. Slow and even. That rolling pattern is the sound of folk and country fingerstyle.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: If you can hold the Travis pattern for five minutes without speeding up, you have a second texture. Huge.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Fingerpicking intro done. Lesson 19: read any chord chart or TAB and learn songs on your own.
